CarpigianiAbout.p1: CARPIGIANI GROUP is the best-known manufacturer of commercial ice cream equipment. The company accounts for about 50% of the world market for machines that make Italian gelato and soft serve.
CarpigianiAbout.p2: Today the company makes batch freezers, pasteurizers and other equipment under the Carpigiani, Coldelite, Ice Team 1927, Ott-Freezer, Promag, Sencotel and GBG brands.
CarpigianiAbout.p3: In 2003 the company founded <link>Carpigiani Gelato University</link>, a school that trains ice cream professionals. Courses take place at the company headquarters in Anzola dell'Emilia and in other countries. In 2012 the Carpigiani Gelato Museum opened, dedicated to the history, culture and technology of gelato making.
CarpigianiAbout.p4: Our company is the official distributor of CARPIGIANI GROUP in Ukraine. We design projects and select equipment for you, and provide warranty and post-warranty service.

IfiAbout.p1: IFI is a high-end Italian manufacturer specialising in display cases and ready-made solutions for bar counters. IFI products are best described by cutting-edge design, innovation and high build quality. Display cases such as PANORAMA and TONDA were so successful and innovative that they started whole new directions in the gelato display case industry: other manufacturers follow and imitate them.
IfiAbout.panelsTitle: The display cases come with several options of decorative panels:
IfiAbout.panel1: No panels. Only the technical part of the case is supplied; on site it is clad with the customer's own materials.
IfiAbout.panel2: RAL 9010. The case comes with standard white decorative panels, RAL 9010.
IfiAbout.panel3: LC RAL. The case is made with decorative panels in any RAL colour the customer chooses.
IfiAbout.p2: Most display cases come in several versions that look the same but have different technical equipment inside, so each is made for showing a different kind of product: gelato, chocolate, pastry, baked goods or deli food.

IsaAbout.p1: ISA is a well-known Italian manufacturer of refrigeration equipment and ready-made solutions for cafés, restaurants and shops.
IsaAbout.p2: The company manages to keep high standards of appearance and build quality while keeping prices affordable. Thanks to this, gelato display cases such as <carrettino>CARRETTINO DEI GELATI</carrettino> and <millennium>MILLENNIUM</millennium> have been bestsellers for many years. The new <oneshow>ONESHOW</oneshow> and <supercapri>SUPERCAPRI</supercapri> models have become bestsellers in recent years.
